create_builder_fbnet: create an FBNetBuilder and architecture definition from a maskrcnn-benchmark config object
build_fbnet_backbone: build an FBNet backbone model using FBNetTrunk with a given builder and architecture definition
build_fbnet_rpn_head: build an FBNet RPN head with feature extraction and convolution regressor from config
build_fbnet_roi_head: build an FBNet ROI head for bounding box, keypoint, or mask feature extraction from config
review_fbnet_classes: review the FBNetTrunk, FBNetRPNHead, and FBNetROIHead classes and their forward methods
